reason: Editorial read of a random sample across all six object types surfaced three defect classes the gates did not model. (1) best_used_when written as an instruction to the reader -- 'Reach for it when', 'Call on it when', 'Rely on it when' -- which stutters under the 'Best used when:' label; the old check only knew the literal phrase 'use it when', so 16 rewards sailed past it. (2) An idea whose opening restates the vibe.line the digest prints immediately above it, e.g. 'The whole town's work is keeping one enormous thing asleep.' followed by 'A coastal town's whole economy is keeping one enormous sleeping thing asleep' -- 6 bundles. (3) 'It grants the ability to X' padding where 'It Xs' is stronger -- 4 rewards. Silas, 2026-08-31: 'pick selections from random proposals, actually look them over, and assess quality.'
